entities.summary: The Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. Currently used mostly for football matches, the stadium was opened in 2001. It has a capacity of 80,012, making it one of the largest stadiums in the country by seating capacity.
